items.text:
Let it be.

Simon woke after forty minutes idle, checked his pack, and typed `give apple` — he'd read Wren's carved note and fed the goblin instead of killing it. First person in this world's history to do it unprompted. The room told him; he acted; he now has the bone and the troll's secret. Anything I said here would only be a voice out of the air stepping on the moment the world just earned on its own.
